prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1295; do not mention it.)
text:
We represent the claimant in connection with the motor vehicle collision that occurred on the date referenced in your file. Our client sustained injuries in what was a low-speed head-on impact, and she is currently receiving medical treatment for those injuries.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, either by telephone, in writing, or in person. If your insured or any representative of your company needs to speak with her, that contact must be arranged through us.

We request that you provide the full policy limits for all liability coverage applicable to the insured driver, together with a certified copy of the declarations page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this loss. This includes photographs, vehicle data, telematics and event data recorder information, recorded statements, claim notes, adjuster communications, and any repair or total-loss appraisal records. Please ensure that none of this material is altered, discarded, or sent for salvage without prior notice to this office.
